description: This Kotlin source file defines the CoilImagesPlugin class, a plugin for Markwon that integrates Coil image loading with custom authentication headers, specifically for loading images from sync providers like Nextcloud. It manages image request loading, cancellation, and drawable updates, and provides factory methods for creating plugin instances with custom or default configurations.
